name: OT Form Report
query:
SELECT 
    ot.date AS "Date:Data:90",
    ot.patient AS "Patient:Data:80",
    ot.patient_name AS "Patient Name:Data:150",
    p.mobile_no AS "Mobile No:Data:120",
    p.p_age AS "Age:Data:60",
    p.age_type AS "Age Type:Data:80",
    p.sex AS "Sex:Data:80",
    ot.doctor AS "Doctor Name:Data:250",
    ot.procedure_name AS "Procedure Name:Data:200",
    ot.eye_side AS "Eye Side:Data:100",
    ot.amount AS "Amount:Currency:80",
    ot.laboratory_tests_done AS "Laboratory Tests Done:Data:120",
    ot.iol_calculation_done AS "IOL Calculation Done:Data:120",
    ot.consent_form_signed AS "Consent Form Signed:Data:120",
    ot.admission_done AS "Admission Done:Data:120",
    ot.call_status AS "Call Status:Data:120",
    ot.remarks AS "Remarks:Data:300"
FROM 
    `tabOT Form` ot
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabPatient` p ON ot.patient = p.name
WHERE 
    ot.date BETWEEN %(Start_date)s AND %(End_date)s;
